description: This file is a shell script containing tests and setup procedures for testing 'git checkout' command behavior, including handling various options and edge cases.

methods.name: do_checkout
methods.description: Performs a 'git checkout' with specified options, branch name, and optional commit ID, and verifies expected state.

methods.name: test_dirty_unmergeable
methods.description: Verifies that unmergeable uncommitted changes cause 'git diff' to exit with code 1.

methods.name: test_dirty_unmergeable_discards_changes
methods.description: Checks that discarding unmergeable changes via 'git diff' works as expected.

methods.name: setup_dirty_unmergeable
methods.description: Sets up the repository with unmergeable changes in files.

methods.name: test_dirty_mergeable
methods.description: Verifies that mergeable staged changes cause 'git diff --cached' to exit with code 1.

methods.name: test_dirty_mergeable_discards_changes
methods.description: Checks that discarding mergeable staged changes works without error.

methods.name: setup_dirty_mergeable
methods.description: Prepares the repository with mergeable changes staged for commit.
